memories.content: Alex is a senior software engineer based in Bangalore, India.
Prefers writing backend services in Python and FastAPI with strict typing.
Always uses dark mode for all code editors, IDEs, and browser applications.
Architect an autonomous personal AI assistant called E.D.I.T.H. by end of 2026.
Decided to use SQLite with WAL mode for zero-cost reliable local persistence.
